area-set integration test sorts before asserting, so the "in file order" half of the 15-areas scenario is pinned only on the inline fixture (harness.rs:3745)
Ledger fields are pub and check_unique_ids runs only inside parse, so a hand-constructed Ledger can carry a duplicate id unchecked (coverage.rs:287)
nit: zs values mix issue numbers, a code tag, and a prose label ("sandbox hardening"), matching no single entry-name convention in ROADMAP_ZS.md

possible shotgun surgery: the four reject_foreign_evidence tables hand-enumerate each status's complement (coverage.rs:175-241); a dropped entry silently reopens the ignored-field hole, and only 1 of 11 pairs was tested
possible speculative generality: Ledger::audit_matches (coverage.rs:298) has no caller outside its own unit test; coverage.rs is the only src/ module with no path from main.rs
possible loops: check_unique_ids is O(n^2) via reported.contains plus an inner filter (coverage.rs:381-417), check_ids is O(n*m) (coverage.rs:342-353); HashSet is already in the repo's vocabulary
minor doc over-claim: coverage.rs:11-12 says four rules are "enforced here", but rule 2 is enforced by schema absence and rule 4 only by an integration test
minor data inconsistency: zs values use three citation formats across coverage.toml:141, :312, :632 against a doc calling it "a tracking entry"
